modeling_decisions: Concept inspected. Retain a single gentle S-shaped fill with quiet surrounding rock and homogeneous solid end. Correct any apparent carved trench/outer pale wall: fill must meet unlined host directly; no raised sheath or broad halo. Use about12mm diameter, modest half-embedded relief and two broad turns rather than tight repeated U loops. A visible end cut is illustrative, not a claimed excavated exposure. Both ends may meet slab edge, and host/trace share a seamless boundary in one closed surface with no hidden stacked slab faces. Smooth faceted tube remains readable in top and clay; do not rotate or reuse a Skolithos mesh.
repair_rationale: r002 constrained profile removes jagged fill-edge artifacts and now exposes homogeneous end fill. Diagnostic hero/clay/top personally inspected. Source audit nevertheless reports20 boundary edges at separately indexed cut-face subdivisions, so reject and share cut-face shoulder vertices to close topology without changing shape, lining status or original scope.
